sources.title: CoMIR: Contrastive Multimodal Image Representation for Registration
sources.scope: Primary paper: BF–SHG 206 image pairs and official 40/25/7/134 roles; 2048 full cores and 834 crop; Zurich identity; C4/InfoNCE representations; SIFT/alpha-AMD/Mattes-MI routes; historical registration metric. Not a reproduction.

sources.title: Multimodal Biomedical Dataset for Evaluating Registration Methods (Full-size TMA Cores)
sources.scope: Official data record: image shape, train/validation1/validation2/test roles and counts, modality filename examples, archive sizes and md5 metadata. No archive downloaded and no patient mapping established.

sources.title: Multimodal Biomedical Dataset for Evaluating Registration Methods (cropped CoMIR benchmark)
sources.scope: Existence and provenance link verified from CoMIR author repository and full-core official record. Direct record retrieval failed; contents and availability of archive not verified.

sources.title: Non-disruptive collagen characterization in clinical histopathology using cross-modality image synthesis
sources.scope: Primary data-origin paper, histological sample and imaging sections; describes a larger source study. Does not establish a patient-ID mapping for CoMIR's 206 pairs.

sources.title: EPFL RGB-NIR Scene Dataset
sources.scope: Official page: 477 entries in 9 named categories, separate RGB/NIR exposures, published TIFF 1024x768 download about 1 GB, SIFT/RANSAC alignment. No fixed registration split or redistribution license verified; archive not acquired.

sources.title: Multispectral SIFT for Scene Category Recognition
sources.scope: Author PDF: explicit 477 paired images; similarity alignment; inter-exposure motion in some scenes; original scene-recognition evaluation uses 99 test images and 10 randomized trials. These are not fixed registration splits.

sources.title: MIDA-group/CoMIR author repository
sources.scope: README native train-biodata/train-zurich entrypoints, requirement of aligned training pairs, common image-like representations, SIFT/Fiji and MI/Matlab routes. Source implementation not installed or executed.

sources.title: MIDA-group/MultiRegEval author evaluation framework
sources.scope: README evaluate.py/evaluate_3D.py, CoMIR training/prediction scripts, SimpleElastix requirement. No execution.

sources.title: SimpleITK ImageRegistrationMethod API
sources.scope: SetMetricAsMattesMutualInformation documented API and histogram-bins parameter. Not a measured native baseline.

sources.title: Elastix NormalizedMutualInformationMetric
sources.scope: Parzen-window NMI metric, parameter name, histogram-bin and B-spline configuration. Does not establish installed runtime availability.

sources.title: scikit-image metrics: normalized_mutual_information
sources.scope: Studholme NMI=(H(A)+H(B))/H(A,B), histogram bins, and zero-padding of mismatched shapes; numerical-reference use only.

sources.title: MIND: Modality independent neighbourhood descriptor for multi-modal deformable registration
sources.scope: Primary publisher excerpt: self-similarity descriptor, dense computation, SSD comparison, linear/deformable registration. Original formula/code was not fully audited; author software page retrieval failed.

sources.title: Self-supervised Representation Learning with Relative Predictive Coding
sources.scope: Primary full paper: beta multiplies P quadratic and gamma multiplies Q quadratic; optimum (p-alpha*q)/(beta*p+gamma*q). alpha=beta=gamma=1 exactly equals VCS J. Checked main and appendix; no model reproduction.

sources.title: Relative Predictive Coding author repository
sources.scope: Author repository identity found in web retrieval; direct open failed. No code installed or audited.

sources.title: Relative Density-Ratio Estimation for Robust Distribution Comparison
sources.scope: Primary paper sections 2.1/2.2: relative ratio and PE, least-squares risk, kernel basis, ridge linear system, bandwidth/ridge CV. Independent algebra in protocol shows Rtilde(1+T)=-1/2-J(T)/2 at alpha=1/2.

sources.title: Makoto Yamada's RuLSIF software page
sources.scope: Author page confirms relative ratio/PE definitions and Matlab software link. Archive not downloaded.

sources.title: Masashi Sugiyama software page
sources.scope: Author-maintained software listing points to RuLSIF Matlab/R/Python implementations; not proof that those runtime artifacts currently work.

sources.title: Provable Guarantees for Self-Supervised Deep Learning with Spectral Contrastive Loss
sources.scope: Primary paper: normalized augmentation graph factorization, positive/negative pair definitions, Eq.6 spectral objective -2 E_P dot + E_Q dot^2. No claim of VCS-objective identity or transfer of classification theorem to registration.

sources.title: Spectral contrastive learning author PyTorch implementation
sources.scope: README official implementation and CIFAR/ResNet18 pretraining/evaluation entrypoints; cross-modal registration adaptation not present or verified.

sources.title: Learning Deep Kernels for Non-Parametric Two-Sample Tests
sources.scope: Primary paper: deep kernel architecture, MMD^2/standard-deviation power objective, held-out kernel testing; distinct from S estimation. No claimed registration reproduction.

sources.title: ICML 2020 proceedings entry for Learning Deep Kernels
sources.scope: Official paper metadata and software link.

sources.title: DK-for-TST official source code
sources.scope: Official code repository identity/readme; not installed or executed.

sources.title: V9 recovered server protocol: REG extension
sources.scope: Historical project grouping, BF thresholds 42/9 native px, EPFL thresholds 10.5/2.25 px, development exposure, 33 previous EPFL exclusions, two benchmark tables. Not current server execution evidence.

sources.title: V9 recovered server protocol: Data and benchmarks
sources.scope: Historical EPFL identity/exclusions/approximately 2px alignment limit; requirements for role and source-ID audits. No exact exclusion IDs available here.

sources.title: V10 accepted candidate design v0.1: Moment-Factorized VCS
sources.scope: Accepted method and constraints: M0/M1, bounded bilinear, full encoders, within-scene V/permutation rule, warp-then-encode, fixed test W. Not current server state.
